{{Quote|Our pride demands that our enemy be executed by our own hand&mdash;or by our proxy.|Vedo Anjiliac Atirue|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
'''Vedo Anjiliac Atirue''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the leader of [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], the uncle of [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]], and a member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. He was also a close friend of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ho, ho, ho! The legendary Admiral Stazi vouching for the pirate? The galaxy has gone mad. Done. Vedo out.|Vedo Anjiliac Atirue after Gar Stazi vouched for Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]] in the [[Devastation of Da Soocha|devastation]] of [[Da Soocha]] and [[Napdu]] by the [[One Sith]], Azzim's [[Gender/Legends|uncle]]<ref name="Legacy 48" /> Vedo Anjiliac Atirue wanted revenge. [[Jool]] spoke highly of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Cade Skywalker]] who could get the job Vedo had in mind done, and he asked her to contact Skywalker. Before meeting with the pirate, Vedo laid a trap for [[Vul Isen]], the Sith scientist who had created the [[Viral spore|toxin]] used to purge [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and Da Soocha of all life, using [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] as bait. Forwarding Stazi's whereabouts on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], Vedo knew that Isen would come to not only kill Stazi, but to purge Utapau of all life and the many Alliance personnel taking refuge there.<ref name="Legacy 49" />

Arriving on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with [[Wolf Sazen]], [[Jariah Syn]], and [[Deliah Blue]], Skywalker and his friends preceded to [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue's headquarters|Vedo's headquarters]], where they found [[Naxy Screeger]] working as Vedo's gatekeeper. Screeger believed Skywalker owed him for information that Isen was on [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]]. As that proved false, Skywalker refused to pay. When Skywalker walked forward, Screeger stated that only Skywalker was invited by Vedo and separated the party with a barrier than fell from the ceiling. Several [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] then attacked Skywalker, but he easily dispatched them with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Legacy 49" />

Vedo apologized for the test and stated that he needed to see if Skywalker was really as good as Jool claimed. She also apologized, stating that she perhaps spoke of Skywalker ''too'' highly. Vedo made an offer to Skywalker to kill Isen; as Skywalker was already hunting the Sith scientist, he thought he might as well get paid for it, but he did not know where Isen was. When Vedo informed Skywalker of the trap on Utapau, the pirate was furious, but the Hutt was not concerned about the risks since he had no business interests on that world. He explained that hiring Skywalker as the Hutts' agent meant the enemy would die by the Hutts' hand. As Utapau and the Alliance were already at risk, Skywalker could see no other choice but to accept; if he failed, the Sith would win and would become a much larger threat than any resulting Hutt anger. Vedo informed Skywalker that a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] agent named [[Pobos]] would meet him there. Although Pobos was killed by a Sith [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]],<ref name="Legacy 49" /> Skywalker ultimately succeeded in killing Isen and prevented him from releasing his plague on the planet.<ref name="Legacy 50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>

Vedo along with other Hutts presented bounties for those who could kill Sith and collect their lightsabers. Vedo again employed Cade to kill more Sith as a way to contribute to the war, but not be officially in it. When Cade destroyed a Star Destroyer but had no lightsabers to prove it, Vedo questioned the loyalty and honesty of a pirate, but Gar Stazi vouched for Skywalker as Rogue Squadron was present when Skywalker destroyed the Imperial warship.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />
